mapper.insert: insert into jsh_stock_warning_status (tenant_id, material_id, depot_id, warning_type, active, current_stock, notify_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{tenantId}, #{materialId}, #{depotId}, #{warningType}, #{active}, #{currentStock}, case when #{active} then current_timestamp else null end, current_timestamp, current_timestamp) on conflict (tenant_id, material_id, depot_id, warning_type) do nothing
mapper.update: update jsh_stock_warning_status set active = #{active}, current_stock = #{currentStock}, notify_time = case when #{notified} then current_timestamp else notify_time end, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id}
